description: This file is a PHP template for rendering a web page layout, utilizing a templating engine with methods like layout(), section(), supply(), and replace() to compose dynamic content.

methods.name: layout
methods.description: Sets the base layout template for this page.

methods.name: section
methods.description: Defines a content section named 'content' to be filled in the layout.

methods.name: supply
methods.description: Inserts inner content into the template at the 'inner-content' placeholder.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Finalizes the template rendering, replacing placeholders with actual content.
